name: Cimentas Izmir Cimento Fabrikasi Turk A.S.
summary: Çimentas Izmir Çimento Fabrikasi Türk A.S., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells cement, and ready mix concrete in Turkey and internationally. The company is also engaged in fuel sales, fly ash, and waste management businesses. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Izmir, Turkey. Çimentas Izmir Çimento Fabrikasi Türk A.S. is a subsidiary of Aalborg Portland España S.L.
